hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const f=j.tool_response?.filePath||j.tool_input?.file_path;if(f&&/\.(ts|tsx)$/.test(f)){process.stdout.write(f)}else{process.exit(0)}})" | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ]; then npx prettier --write "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true

echo '{"systemMessage": "Tool routing: Use Serena (find_symbol, get_symbols_overview, replace_symbol_body) for code navigation, symbol lookup, and refactoring. Use Context7 (resolve-library-id, query-docs) for library/framework documentation. Use chrome browser tools for UI testing and visual verification."}'
